publicationReference.description: A typed reference to the notice identifying the procurement procedure. Maps to one cac:AdditionalDocumentReference in UBL.

type.description: DocrefcontentType code identifying the kind/location of publication. The enum is DERIVED from ESPD-EDM/codelists/DocrefcontentType.gc (the single source of truth); sectionA.test.mjs asserts it stays in sync. Regenerate if the codelist changes.
